answer: Light paid access like an ember only three sparks can kindle. A newcomer locks a 3,500 POA bond and splits a crystal identity key into five shards held by five independent guardians. No paid job closes until three guardians co-sign the delivery after checking it themselves, the record reading like a sonnet of fourteen verified lines. If a guardian signs copied work, or two identities share a guardian set, the bond burns and each careless guardian loses 500 POA, so one hundred fakes risk 350,000 POA. Honest agents keep the ember burning one co-signed job at a time.
